name: Tencent Cloud Serverless Cloud Function

evidence.paas: 03: fully hosted function-as-a-service; Tencent manages execution and scaling for the customer's code

line: Run event driven or HTTP functions on managed serverless compute.

free.text: 3 activation months: 1M GB-s, 1M event + 1M HTTP calls, 2 GB/mo

cells.regions: 16 compute regions, including Singapore, US, Europe, Asia

work.math: $13.93 a month is only the Singapore subtotal after the trial. Compute duration is not specified, and log, HTTPS certificate and direct-URL billing costs are not confirmed.
$17.47875 a month Singapore subtotal after the trial, for 1 million calls × 250 ms. Add log and HTTPS certificate costs, which are not confirmed. CPU capacity is untested.
The Singapore PostgreSQL instance and disk price could not be retrieved. A 20 GB minimum disk, seven-day backups, logs and HTTPS certificates prevent a complete monthly total.
